#### CopyEngine.cs — New method `IsAtmSlotName` (insert as `internal static`)

Add as a new method in the helpers region (near other `internal static` helpers):

```csharp
// DW-B32-TRIM-CLOSE-01: ATM slot name detector.
// CYC=5: null/length guard(2), Stop prefix+digit(2), Target prefix+digit(1).
// internal static -- CopyEngineTests.cs calls directly without NT8 runtime.
internal static bool IsAtmSlotName(string name)
{
    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) || name.Length < 5)
        return false;
    if (name.StartsWith("Stop", StringComparison.Ordinal)
        && name.Length > 4
        && char.IsDigit(name[4]))
        return true;
    if (name.StartsWith("Target", StringComparison.Ordinal)
        && name.Length > 6
        && char.IsDigit(name[6]))
        return true;
    return false;
}
```

**NT8 note**: `string.IsNullOrEmpty` and `string.StartsWith(string, StringComparison)` are
available in .NET Framework 4.8. `char.IsDigit` is available in .NET Framework 4.8.
No banned NT8 types introduced.

#### CopyEngine.cs — New method `IsAtmBracketActive` (insert as `private bool`)

Add adjacent to `IsAtmSlotName` in the helpers region:

```csharp
// DW-B32-TRIM-CLOSE-01: scan working orders for any ATM bracket leg on this instrument.
// CYC=6: foreach(1), instrument continue(2), Working state(3), Accepted state(4),
//        FromEntrySignal+IsAtmSlotName check(5). Null guard on acc/instrument(6 implicit).
// lock-free: acc.Orders.ToList() snapshot (JS-021 pattern).
private bool IsAtmBracketActive(Account acc, Instrument instrument)
{
    if (acc == null || instrument == null)
        return false;
    foreach (var order in acc.Orders.ToList())
    {
        if (order.Instrument != instrument)
            continue;
        if (order.OrderState != OrderState.Working
            && order.OrderState != OrderState.Accepted)
            continue;
        if (order.FromEntrySignal == null && IsAtmSlotName(order.Name))
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}
```

**NT8 notes**:
- `acc.Orders` is the `IList<Order>` collection on `NinjaTrader.Cbi.Account`. `.ToList()` takes
  a snapshot to avoid collection-modified exceptions during iteration (established pattern in
  `CancelOneAccount`).
- `order.Instrument` reference equality is used throughout the file (see `FindPosition`).
- `OrderState.Working` and `OrderState.Accepted` are confirmed valid NT8 enum values
  (NT8-031 checked).
- `order.FromEntrySignal` is a `string` property; null means the order was NOT created by a PTT
  entry signal (i.e. it was created by NT8 ATM engine).

// DW-B32-TRIM-CLOSE-01: block raw market sell when ATM bracket is active.
// acc.Change() on ATM-owned Stop/Target slots is silently rejected (DW-B32-07 confirmed).
// User must use native Chart Trader Target/Close buttons to exit within an ATM bracket.

    NinjaTrader.Code.Output.Process(
        "PTT-Trim: " + acc.Name + " -- ATM bracket active, use native Target/Close buttons",
        PrintTo.OutputTab1);
    StatusUpdate?.Invoke(acc.Name + ": PTT-Trim blocked -- ATM bracket active");
    return;
}
